title: Exploiting the Margin: How Capitalism Fuels AI at the Expense of Minoritized Groups
findings: The paper finds that AI systems can amplify prejudicial stereotypes against religious individuals, citing the case of a recent convert to Islam who was erroneously matched to a crime by an FBI algorithm. This wrongful identification, influenced by stereotypes, led to significant personal and financial costs for the individual, illustrating how religious identity can become a component of algorithmic bias and harm.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct a formal benchmark. It provides a qualitative analysis of how prejudicial stereotypes against a religious identity (Islam) can lead to negative outcomes when combined with AI systems, as illustrated by the wrongful identification of Brandon Mayfield.
